name: Fsilon Furnishing and Construction Materials Corporation
summary: Fsilon Furnishing and Construction Materials Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of integrated ceilings, integrated walls panels, and other products in China. The company offers modules and electrical appliances. Its products are used in prefabricated interior decoration, building interior decoration, and other applications. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
